flags.message: The provisioned filings contain materially conflicting accounts, not an established provisioning defect: the petition asserts absent meaningful review, while the BIO's December 10, 2024 hearing transcript records guidepost discussion. The remittitur motion and initial hearing argument use $1.3 million punitive/$167,000 compensatory, while the petition, BIO, and correction at the hearing identify $800,000 punitive and additional compensatory damages. Forecast relies on the transcript and corrected award account, not the initial 7.8:1 assertion; see reasoning.md.
